# ankra_oidc_trust_policies (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's GitHub Actions OIDC trust policies, oldest first. Needs `members.manage` on a person's own API token: service tokens and tokens pinned to a project are refused.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_oidc_trust_policies" "all" {}

# Fail the plan when any policy lets pull request runs mint tokens.
check "no_pull_request_trust" {
  assert {
    condition     = alltrue([for policy in data.ankra_oidc_trust_policies.all.policies : !policy.allow_pull_request])
    error_message = "An OIDC trust policy lets pull request runs exchange tokens."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `policies` (Attributes List) Trust policies of the organisation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `allow_pull_request` (Boolean) Whether pull request runs may exchange tokens.
- `created_at` (String) When the policy was created.
- `environment` (String) Deployment environment the job must run in; null for any.
- `id` (String) Trust policy ID.
- `job_workflow_ref` (String) Workflow a run must come from; null for any.
- `name` (String) Policy name.
- `ref` (String) Git ref a run must be on; null for any.
- `repository_id` (Number) GitHub's numeric ID of the repository.
- `repository_name` (String) Name of the trusted repository.
- `repository_owner` (String) GitHub owner of the trusted repository.
- `repository_owner_id` (Number) GitHub's numeric ID of the owner.
- `role_slug` (String) Role of the policy's service account.
- `scopes` (List of String) Scopes the minted tokens are narrowed to; empty for the role's full authority.
- `service_account_id` (String) Service account the minted tokens belong to.
- `ttl_seconds` (Number) Lifetime of each minted token, in seconds.
